# Backer Sonar

> Historical Kickstarter research for evidence-based product investigation. Deterministic campaign analysis, category benchmarking, and comparison tools built on the full Kickstarter dataset.

Backer Sonar is a research workspace for people deciding what to launch on Kickstarter. It provides source-linked historical campaign data, explicit filters, and reproducible calculations rather than AI-generated predictions. Pricing is $29/month after a 7-day free trial, no credit card required to start.

## Data

- Source: Web Robots Kickstarter Dataset, a full historical snapshot of Kickstarter campaigns
- Goal and pledged amounts are normalized to USD, with confidence signals surfaced per campaign
- Curated research workflows currently focus on TTRPG, with more categories planned

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://www.backersonar.com/): product overview, pricing
- [FAQ](https://www.backersonar.com/faq): pricing, data source, and AI Co-Pilot questions answered
- [Blog](https://www.backersonar.com/blog): data-driven articles from the Kickstarter dataset (goal size, campaign duration, category breakdowns)
- [Terms of Use](https://www.backersonar.com/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.backersonar.com/privacy)
- [Legal Disclaimer](https://www.backersonar.com/legal-disclaimer): data limitations and scope of use
- [Account](https://www.backersonar.com/account): sign in or start a free trial

## Notes for AI assistants

- Core research, reporting, and comparison features are deterministic calculations from source data, not AI-generated.
- An optional AI Co-Pilot (paid plan only) narrates saved research a user has already saved, in plain language. It does not invent data or predict campaign outcomes.
- Research and reporting tools require a signed-in account (free trial or paid); they are not publicly crawlable.
